summary: Iteration 8 (flags system + org branding + color-coded categories + buy/show links + DnD) tested end-to-end. Found and FIXED a critical Pydantic model bug: ShowPayload and Show did not declare show_link, causing POST /api/shows and PUT /api/shows/{id} to 500 whenever the client sent show_link (identical pattern to Iter-7 group_id bug). After the fix all 27 backend pytest tests pass (7 new TestIteration8 tests + 20 legacy). Frontend key data-testids verified live via Playwright: brand-org-name + brand-logo-fallback show custom org name and initials; /flags page renders with 3 seeded flag categories (On Loan / Needs Repair / In Cleaning) and add-flag works; Shows page shows-add-btn opens show-form-dialog and creates a show; ShowDetail show-add-costumes-btn opens show-picker-dialog with items and attach button; CostumeFormDialog exposes form-buy-link, form-flags-section, form-flag-add-select; CostumeDetail renders detail-flag-banner, detail-flag-{id}, and detail-cat-color; Inventory grid cards are draggable=true and, upon dragstart, dnd-dock reveals 10 dnd-drop-cat-* and 9 dnd-drop-loc-* drop targets; Settings has settings-logo-upload-btn and cat-color-picker-{id} shown after expanding a category row.

issues: Existing legacy costumes flagged via is_flagged/flag_reason (before flags array introduced) do NOT appear under any Flag Category section (e.g. 'Black Trenchcoat' shown as flagged on Dashboard but 'On Loan' section shows 0 costumes). Non-blocking but consider a one-time data migration to attach an 'On Loan' flag to legacy flagged rows.

action_items: REVIEW the fix: added Optional show_link field to Show and ShowPayload models in /app/backend/server.py (was causing 500 on show create/update).
Optional: one-time migration to convert legacy is_flagged/flag_reason costumes to a flags-array entry so they appear in the /flags page category buckets.
critical_code_review_comments: Recurring bug pattern (3rd occurrence — iter 7 group_id, iter 8 show_link, and buy_link avoided it): whenever a new field is added to a resource, the developer must add it to BOTH the response model (Show/Costume) AND the payload model (ShowPayload/CostumeBase/CostumeUpdate). Consider generating request models from a shared base or adding a startup schema sanity check.
server.py is now 1410 lines. Split into routers/ (costumes, groups, categories, flag_categories, shows, settings, uploads). Iteration 8 added ~250 lines and CRUD for flag categories & attaches.
/api/flag-categories delete cascade uses a two-step approach ($pull then find $size:0). Correct but not atomic. At scale, consider a single aggregation pipeline update.
/api/inventory continues its N+1 query pattern (one costumes.find per group). Fine at current scale.
Category color update accepts arbitrary string — no hex validation. Not a blocker but easy to add (^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$).
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (added show_link: Optional[str] to Show and ShowPayload)
/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestIteration8 class: 7 tests covering settings/org, flag CRUD + cascade, multi-flag costume, buy_link, category color + rename cascade, show_link)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested testids present and interactive

seed_data_creation: All test entities use TEST_* prefix and are cleaned up after each test. Manually cleaned up one leftover TEST_UI_FLAG_XYZ + TEST_UI_SHOW_ABC from Playwright runs; re-added seeded 'On Loan' flag category after a wrong-target UI delete during exploration.

Backend needed one fix: show_link added to Show + ShowPayload. All 27 pytest tests pass. Frontend testids verified: brand-*, flags-page, new-flag-*, edit-flag-btn-*, delete-flag-btn-*, shows-add-btn, show-form-dialog, show-add-costumes-btn, show-picker-*, form-buy-link, form-flags-section, form-flag-add-select, form-flag-note-*, detail-flag-banner, detail-flag-*, detail-cat-color, dnd-dock, dnd-drop-cat-*, dnd-drop-loc-*, settings-logo-upload-btn, cat-color-picker-*.
rca of the issue: POST /api/shows returned 500 with AttributeError: 'ShowPayload' object has no attribute 'show_link'. Handler at server.py:1054 referenced payload.show_link but the Pydantic ShowPayload class did not declare it. Same class of bug as iter-7 CostumeBase.group_id. Root cause: developer added show_link to handler + Show response class + FE payload but forgot the request model. Fix applied: added show_link: Optional[str] = '' to both Show and ShowPayload. Verified via test_show_link_persists (POST → GET → PUT → GET round-trip).
